eta eva svasaṃjñābhiḥ tamo moho mahāmohas tāmisro 'ndhatāmisra iti tamo+moho · eta eva svasaṃjñābhiḥ tamo moho mahāmohas tāmisro 'ndhatāmisra iti moho+mahāmohas · sukhānuśayī rāgaḥ duḥkhānuśayī dveṣo mohaḥ punar avidyeti dveṣo+mohaḥ · te khalu nava yogino mṛdumadhyādhimātropāyā bhavanti yogino+mṛdu

atas tasyāṃ viraktaṃ cittaṃ tām api khyātiṃ niruṇaddhi tadavasthaṃ cittaṃ saṃskāropagaṃ bhavati sa nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ na tatra kiṃcit samprajñāyata iti asaṃprajñātaḥ samprajñāyata+iti · tatra vairāgyeṇa viṣayasrotaḥ khilīkriyate vivekadarśanābhyāsena vivekasrota udghāṭyata ity ubhayādhīnaścittavṛttinirodhaḥ udghāṭyata+ity · prāptaṃ prāpaṇīyaṃ kṣīṇāḥ kṣetavyāḥ kleśāḥ chinnaḥ śliṣṭaparvā bhavasaṃkramaḥ yasyāvicchedāj janitvā mriyate mṛtvā ca jāyata iti jāyata+iti · sālambano hy abhyāsas tatsādhanāya na kalpata iti virāmapratyayo nirvastuka ālambanīkriyate kalpata+iti

tathājātīyakāḥ saṃskārā vṛttibhir eva kriyante saṃskāraiśca vṛttaya iti saṃskārā+vṛttibhir · sarvāścaitā vṛttayaḥ sukhaduḥkhamohātmikāḥ etāḥ→sarvāścaitā +vṛttayaḥ · etāḥ sarvā vṛttayo niroddhavyāḥ sarvā+vṛttayo · avidyādayaḥ kleśāḥ kuśalākuśalāni karmāṇi tatphalaṃ vipākaḥ tadanuguṇā vāsanā āśayāḥ anuguṇāḥ→tadanuguṇā +vāsanā

yad idam atītānāgatapratyutpannapratyekasamuccayātīndriyagrahaṇam alpaṃ bahv iti sarvajñabījam etad vivardhamānaṃ yatra niratiśayaṃ sa sarvajñaḥ vivardhamānaṃ+yatra · yady api hi tattacchāstrānumānācāryopadeśair avagatam arthatattvaṃ sadbhūtam eva bhavati eteṣāṃ yathābhūtārthapratipādanasāmarthyāt tathāpi yāvad ekadeśo 'pi kaścin na svakaraṇasaṃvedyo bhavati tāvat sarvaṃ parokṣam ivāpavargādiṣu sūkṣmeṣv artheṣu na dṛḍhāṃ buddhim utpādayati eteṣāṃ+yathā · svapnajñānālambanaṃ vā nidrājñānālambanaṃ vā tadākāraṃ yoginaścittaṃ sthitipadaṃ labhata iti ākāram→tadākāraṃ +yoginaḥ · tadvaśīkārāt paripūrṇaṃ yoginaścittaṃ na punar abhyāsakṛtaṃ parikarmāpekṣata iti paripūrṇaṃ+yoginaḥ

athāsāṃ nirodhe ka upāya iti ka+upāya · tatra vairāgyeṇa viṣayasrotaḥ khilīkriyate vivekadarśanābhyāsena vivekasrota udghāṭyata ity ubhayādhīnaścittavṛttinirodhaḥ srotaḥ→vivekasrota +udghāṭyata · samāhitacittasya prajñāviveka upāvartate yena yathārthaṃ vastu jānāti vivekaḥ→prajñāviveka +upāvartate · yo 'sau prakṛṣṭasattvopādānād īśvarasya śāśvatika utkarṣaḥ sa kiṃ sanimitta āhosvin nirnimitta iti śāśvatika+utkarṣaḥ

anumeyasya tulyajātīyeṣv anuvṛtto bhinnajātīyebhyo vyāvṛttaḥ saṃbandho yaḥ tadviṣayā sāmānyāvadhāraṇapradhānā vṛttiḥ anumānam anuvṛtto+bhinna · duḥkham aham asvāpsam styānaṃ me mano bhramaty anavasthitam mano+bhramaty · upāyapratyayo bhavapratyayaśca pratyayaḥ→upāyapratyayo +bhava · yady api hi tattacchāstrānumānācāryopadeśair avagatam arthatattvaṃ sadbhūtam eva bhavati eteṣāṃ yathābhūtārthapratipādanasāmarthyāt tathāpi yāvad ekadeśo 'pi kaścin na svakaraṇasaṃvedyo bhavati tāvat sarvaṃ parokṣam ivāpavargādiṣu sūkṣmeṣv artheṣu na dṛḍhāṃ buddhim utpādayati saṃvedyaḥ→svakaraṇasaṃvedyo +bhavati

sa khalv ayaṃ dvividhaḥ ayaṃ+dvividhaḥ · videhānāṃ devānāṃ bhavapratyayaḥ videhānāṃ+devānāṃ · te spandamānā guṇādhikāraṃ draḍhayanti pariṇāmam avasthāpayanti kāryakāraṇasrota unnamayanti parasparānugrahatantrībhūtvā karmavipākaṃ cābhinirharantīti adhikāram→guṇādhikāraṃ +draḍhayanti · satāṃ kleśānāṃ tadā bījasāmarthyaṃ dagdham iti sāmarthyam→bījasāmarthyaṃ +dagdham

tasmāc cittavṛttibodhe puruṣasya anādisaṃbandho hetuḥ tasmāc+citta · yathā deśāntaraprāpter gatimaccandratārakaṃ caitravat gatimat+candra→gatimaccandratārakaṃ · tathā prakṛtilayāḥ sādhikāre cetasi prakṛtilīne kaivalyapadam ivānubhavanti yāvan na punar āvartate 'dhikāravaśāc cittam iti vaśāt→'dhikāravaśāc +cittam · tadabhyāsāt tadviṣayāc ca vairāgyād asaṃprajñātaḥ samādhir bhavati viṣayāt→tadviṣayāc +ca

sarvaśabdāgrahaṇāt samprajñāto 'pi yoga ity ākhyāyate samprajñāto+'pi · gāḍhaṃ mūḍho 'ham asvāpsam gurūṇi me gātrāṇi klāntaṃ me cittam ālasaṃ muṣiṭam iva tiṣṭhatīti mūḍho+'ham · athāsya lābhe bhavaty anyo 'pi kaścid upāyo na veti anyo+'pi · atha pradhānapuruṣavyatiriktaḥ ko 'yam īśvaro nāmeti ko+'yam

sa kasmān na pramāṇam kasmān+na · sā ca samādhāv itarapratyayavan niroddhavyā iti vat→itarapratyayavan +niroddhavyā · tathā prakṛtilayāḥ sādhikāre cetasi prakṛtilīne kaivalyapadam ivānubhavanti yāvan na punar āvartate 'dhikāravaśāc cittam iti yāvan+na · yo 'sau prakṛṣṭasattvopādānād īśvarasya śāśvatika utkarṣaḥ sa kiṃ sanimitta āhosvin nirnimitta iti āhosvin+nirnimitta

tad dvayaṃ vairāgyam tad+dvayaṃ · yenābhihatāḥ prāṇinas tadupaghātāya prayatante tad duḥkham tad+duḥkham · kleśānāṃ yā vṛttayaḥ sthūlās tāḥ kriyāyogena tanūkṛtāḥ satyaḥ prasaṃkhyānena dhyānena hātavyā yāvat sūkṣmīkṛtā yāvad dagdhabījakalpā iti yāvad+dagdha · dṛṣṭajanmavedanīyas tv ekavipākārambhī bhogahetutvād dvivipākārambhī vā bhogāyurhetutvān nandīśvaravan nahuṣavad veti tvāt→bhogahetutvād +dvi

tasmād yasya sāmyātiśayair nivirmuktam aiśvaryaṃ sa eveśvaraḥ sa puruṣaviśeṣa iti sa+eva · sa eṣaḥ sa+eṣaḥ · yatrāvacchedārthena kālo nopāvartate sa eṣa pūrveṣām api guruḥ sa+eṣa · sa sarvaḥ sadṛśapratyayapravāhī vā visadṛśapratyayapravāhī vā pratyarthaniyatatvād ekāgra eveti vikṣiptacittānupapattiḥ ekāgra+eva

buddheḥ pratisaṃvedī puruṣa ityupariṣṭād upapādayiṣyāmaḥ iti+upariṣṭāt→ityupariṣṭād · tatra vairāgyeṇa viṣayasrotaḥ khilīkriyate vivekadarśanābhyāsena vivekasrota udghāṭyata ity ubhayādhīnaścittavṛttinirodhaḥ ity+ubhaya · smṛtyupasthāne ca cittam anākulaṃ samādhīyate smṛti+upasthāne→smṛtyupasthāne · prasaṃkhyānavato dagdhakleśabījasya saṃmukhībhūte 'py ālambane nāsau punar asti dagdhabījasya kutaḥ praroha iti ataḥ kṣīṇakleśaḥ kuśalaścaramadeha ity ucyate ity+ucyate

vastuśūnyatve 'pi śabdajñānamāhātmyanibandhano vyavahāro dṛśyate vyavahāro+dṛśyate · prasaṃkhyānavato dagdhakleśabījasya saṃmukhībhūte 'py ālambane nāsau punar asti dagdhabījasya kutaḥ praroha iti ataḥ kṣīṇakleśaḥ kuśalaścaramadeha ity ucyate prasaṃkhyānavato+dagdha · puruṣo dṛkśaktir buddhir darśanaśaktir ity etayor ekasvarūpāpattir ivāsmitā kleśa ucyate puruṣo+dṛś · duḥkhābhijñasya duḥkhānusmṛtipūrvo duḥkhe tatsādhane vā yaḥ pratigho manyur jighāṃsā krodhaḥ sa dveṣa iti pūrvaḥ→duḥkhānusmṛtipūrvo +duḥkhe

yad idam atītānāgatapratyutpannapratyekasamuccayātīndriyagrahaṇam alpaṃ bahv iti sarvajñabījam etad vivardhamānaṃ yatra niratiśayaṃ sa sarvajñaḥ yad+idam · asti kāṣṭhāprāptiḥ sarvajñabījasya sātiśayatvāt parimāṇavad iti vat→parimāṇavad +iti · saṃśayaḥ ubhayakoṭispṛgvijñānaṃ syād idam evaṃ naivaṃ syād iti syād+idam · saṃśayaḥ ubhayakoṭispṛgvijñānaṃ syād idam evaṃ naivaṃ syād iti syād+iti

yad idam atītānāgatapratyutpannapratyekasamuccayātīndriyagrahaṇam alpaṃ bahv iti sarvajñabījam etad vivardhamānaṃ yatra niratiśayaṃ sa sarvajñaḥ alpaṃ+bahv · yady api hi tattacchāstrānumānācāryopadeśair avagatam arthatattvaṃ sadbhūtam eva bhavati eteṣāṃ yathābhūtārthapratipādanasāmarthyāt tathāpi yāvad ekadeśo 'pi kaścin na svakaraṇasaṃvedyo bhavati tāvat sarvaṃ parokṣam ivāpavargādiṣu sūkṣmeṣv artheṣu na dṛḍhāṃ buddhim utpādayati dṛḍhāṃ+buddhim · cetasi śaktimātrapratiṣṭhānāṃ bījabhāvopagamaḥ pratiṣṭhānām→śaktimātrapratiṣṭhānāṃ +bīja · itaraṃ tu svakarmopahṛtaṃ duḥkham upāttam upāttaṃ tyajantaṃ tyaktaṃ tyaktam upādadānam anādivāsanāvicitrayā cittavṛttyā samantato 'nuviddham ivāvidyāyā hātavya evāhaṃkāramamakārānupātinaṃ jātaṃ jātaṃ bāhyādhyātmikobhayanimittās triparvāṇas tāpā anuplavante jātaṃ+bāhya

sa saṃskāraḥ svavyañjakāñjanas tadākārām eva grāhyagrahaṇobhayātmikāṃ smṛtiṃ janayati smṛtiṃ+janayati · tad asya yoginaḥ praṇavaṃ japataḥ praṇavārthaṃ ca bhāvayataścittam ekāgraṃ saṃpadyate praṇavaṃ+japataḥ · svādhyāyaḥ praṇavādipavitrāṇāṃ japo mokṣaśāstrādhyayanaṃ vā pavitrāṇām→praṇavādipavitrāṇāṃ +japo · naveva śaśāṅkalekhā kamanīyeyaṃ kanyā madhvamṛtāvayavanirmiteva candraṃ bhittvā niḥsṛteva jñāyate nīlotpalapatrāyatākṣī hāvagarbhābhyāṃ locanābhyāṃ jīvalokam āśvāsayantīveti kasya kenābhisaṃbandhaḥ bhavati caivam aśucau śuciviparyāsapratyaya iti locanābhyāṃ+jīva

sa tu sadaiva muktaḥ sadaiveśvara iti sadā+eva→sadaiva · sa tu sadaiva muktaḥ sadaiveśvara iti sadā+eva→sadaiveśvara · etasmād etad bhavati sadaiveśvaraḥ sadaiva mukta iti sadā+eva→sadaiveśvaraḥ · etasmād etad bhavati sadaiveśvaraḥ sadaiva mukta iti sadā+eva→sadaiva

sattvaguṇātmikā ceyam ato viparītā vivekakhyātir iti khyātiḥ→vivekakhyātir +iti · caitrasya gaur iti gaur+iti · atha labdhasthitikasya cetasaḥ kiṃsvarūpā kiṃviṣayā vā samāpattir iti samāpattir+iti · naikasyāṃ striyāṃ caitro rakta ity anyāsu strīṣu viraktaḥ kiṃtu tatra rāgo labdhavṛttir anyatra tu bhaviṣyadvṛttir iti vṛttiḥ→bhaviṣyadvṛttir +iti

ekam eva darśanaṃ khyātir eva darśanam iti khyātir+eva · tathājātīyakāḥ saṃskārā vṛttibhir eva kriyante saṃskāraiśca vṛttaya iti vṛttibhir+eva · yadā citir eva puruṣas tadā kim atra kena vyapadiśyate citir+eva · tatra yad uttaraṃ taj jñānaprasādamātram yasyodaye yogī pratyuditakhyātir evaṃ manyate khyātiḥ→pratyuditakhyātir +evaṃ
tad yathā tad+yathā · tad yathā tad+yathā · tadyathā mṛdūpāyo madhyopāyo 'dhimātropāya iti tat+yathā→tadyathā · tasmād yatra kāṣṭhāprāptir aiśvaryasya sa īśvaraḥ tasmād+yatra

yogānuśāsanaṃ śāstram adhikṛtaṃ veditavyam anuśāsanam→yogānuśāsanaṃ +śāstram · yasya cittasya avasthitasyedaṃ śāstreṇa parikarma nirdiśyate tat katham idam→avasthitasyedaṃ +śāstreṇa · tathāsmitāyāṃ samāpannaṃ cittaṃ nistaraṃgamahodadhikalpaṃ śāntam anantam asmitāmātraṃ bhavati kalpam→nistaraṃgamahodadhikalpaṃ +śāntam · na cendriyāṇāṃ bhogābhyāsena vaitṛṣṇyaṃ kartuṃ śakyam kartuṃ+śakyam

tasmāc cittavṛttibodhe puruṣasya anādisaṃbandho hetuḥ sambandhaḥ→anādisaṃbandho +hetuḥ · ānando hlādaḥ ānando+hlādaḥ · sālambano hy abhyāsas tatsādhanāya na kalpata iti virāmapratyayo nirvastuka ālambanīkriyate ālambanaḥ→sālambano +hy · yo hy anena bhogenāparāmṛṣṭaḥ sa puruṣaviśeṣa īśvaraḥ yo+hy

dvicandradarśanaṃ sadviṣayeṇaikacandradarśanena bādhyate iti sat+viṣayeṇa→sadviṣayeṇaikacandradarśanena · kiṃ pratyayasya cittaṃ smarati āhosvid viṣayasyeti āhosvid+viṣayasya · yad idam atītānāgatapratyutpannapratyekasamuccayātīndriyagrahaṇam alpaṃ bahv iti sarvajñabījam etad vivardhamānaṃ yatra niratiśayaṃ sa sarvajñaḥ etad+vivardhamānaṃ · koṣṭhyasya vāyor nāsikāpuṭābhyāṃ prayatnaviśeṣād vamanaṃ pracchardanam viśeṣāt→prayatnaviśeṣād +vamanaṃ

gatinivṛttau dhātvarthamātraṃ gamyate mātram→dhātvarthamātraṃ +gamyate · te pañca kleśā dagdhabījakalpā yoginaścaritādhikāre cetasi pralīne saha tenaivāstaṃ gacchanti astam→tenaivāstaṃ +gacchanti · kleśakarmavipākānubhavanirvartitābhis tu vāsanābhir anādikālasaṃmūrchitam idaṃ cittaṃ vicitrīkṛtam iva sarvato matsyajālaṃ granthibhir ivātatam ity etā anekabhavapūrvikā vāsanāḥ jālam→matsyajālaṃ +granthibhir · kuśalaṃ hi me bahvanyad asti yatrāyam āvāpaṃ gataḥ svarge 'py apakarṣam alpaṃ kariṣyatīti āvāpaṃ+gataḥ

sa ca vitarkānugato vicārānugata ānandānugato 'smitānugata iti upariṣṭāt pravedayiṣyāmaḥ anugataḥ→vicārānugata +ānanda · yasyāśraddheyārtho vaktā na dṛṣṭānumitārthaḥ sa āgamaḥ plavate mūlavaktari tu dṛṣṭānumitārthe nirviplavaḥ syāt sa+āgamaḥ · vitarkaścittasyālambane sthūla ābhogaḥ sthūla+ābhogaḥ · sālambano hy abhyāsas tatsādhanāya na kalpata iti virāmapratyayo nirvastuka ālambanīkriyate nirvastuka+ālambanīkriyate

anavasthitatvaṃ labdhāyāṃ bhūmau cittasyāpratiṣṭhā tvam→anavasthitatvaṃ +labdhāyāṃ · pramāṇāntaraṃ ca pratyakṣabalenaiva vyavahāraṃ labhate vyavahāraṃ+labhate · tataśca cittaṃ prasīdati prasannam ekāgraṃ sthitipadaṃ labhate padam→sthitipadaṃ +labhate · eṣā dvayī viśokā viṣayavatī asmitāmātrā ca pravṛttir jyotiṣmatīty ucyate yayā yoginaścittaṃ sthitipadaṃ labhata iti padam→sthitipadaṃ +labhata

yas tv ekāgre cetasi sadbhūtam arthaṃ pradyotayati kṣiṇoti ca kleśān karmabandhanāni ślathayati nirodham abhimukhaṃ karoti sa samprajñāto yoga ity ākhyāyate samprajñāto+yoga · tatropāyapratyayo yogināṃ bhavati pratyayaḥ→tatropāyapratyayo +yogināṃ · upāyapratyayo yogināṃ bhavati pratyayaḥ→upāyapratyayo +yogināṃ · prāṇo yad bāhyaṃ vāyum ācāmati sa śvāsaḥ prāṇo+yad

āptena dṛṣṭo 'numito vārthaḥ paratra svabodhasaṃkrāntaye śabdenopadiśyate śabdāt tadarthaviṣayā vṛttiḥ śrotur āgamaḥ śrotur+āgamaḥ · sāmānyamātropasaṃhāre ca kṛtopakṣayam anumānaṃ na viśeṣapratipattau samartham iti tasya saṃjñādiviśeṣapratipattir āgamataḥ paryanveṣyā pratipattiḥ→saṃjñādiviśeṣapratipattir +āgamataḥ · ādividvān nirmāṇacittam adhiṣṭhāya kāruṇyād bhagavān paramarṣir āsuraye jijñāsamānāya tantraṃ provāceti ṛṣiḥ→paramarṣir +āsuraye · sa ca vipākas trividho jātir āyur bhoga iti jātir+āyur

tad eva prakṣīṇamohāvaraṇaṃ sarvataḥ pradyotamānam anuviddhaṃ rajomātrayā dharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryopagaṃ bhavati anuviddhaṃ+rajas · sarvasyāyaṃ rāgānuviddhaś cetanācetanasādhanādhīnaḥ sukhānubhava iti tatrāsti rāgajaḥ karmāśayaḥ ayam→sarvasyāyaṃ +rāga · yathā cikitsāśāstraṃ caturvyūhaṃ rogo rogahetur ārogyaṃ bhaiṣajyam iti evam idam api śāstraṃ caturvyūham eva vyūham→caturvyūhaṃ +rogo · kriyāśīlaṃ rajaḥ śīlam→kriyāśīlaṃ +rajaḥ

atas tasyāṃ viraktaṃ cittaṃ tām api khyātiṃ niruṇaddhi tadavasthaṃ cittaṃ saṃskāropagaṃ bhavati sa nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ na tatra kiṃcit samprajñāyata iti asaṃprajñātaḥ kiṃcit+samprajñāyata · tatsaṃpipādayiṣayā tatsādhanānuṣṭhānam abhyāsaḥ tad+saṃpipādayiṣayā→tatsaṃpipādayiṣayā · tatsaṃpipādayiṣayā tatsādhanānuṣṭhānam abhyāsaḥ tad+sādhana→tatsādhanānuṣṭhānam · sālambano hy abhyāsas tatsādhanāya na kalpata iti virāmapratyayo nirvastuka ālambanīkriyate tad+sādhanāya→tatsādhanāya

vastuśūnyatve 'pi śabdajñānamāhātmyanibandhano vyavahāro dṛśyate tve+'pi · striyo 'nnapānam aiśvaryam iti dṛṣṭaviṣaye vitṛṣṇasya svargavaidehyaprakṛtilayatvaprāptāv ānuśravikaviṣaye vitṛṣṇasya divyādivyaviṣayasaṃprayoge 'pi cittasya viṣayadoṣadarśinaḥ prasaṃkhyānabalād anābhogātmikā heyopādeyaśūnyā vaśīkārasaṃjñā vairāgyam saṃprayoge+'pi · dvayos tulyayor ekasmin yugapat kāmite 'rthe navam idam astu purāṇam idam astv ity ekasya siddhāv itarasya prākāmyavidhātād ūnatvaṃ prasaktam kāmite+'rthe · tasyātmānugrahābhāve 'pi bhūtānugrahaḥ prayojanam jñānadharmopadeśena kalpapralayamahāpralayeṣu saṃsāriṇaḥ puruṣān uddhariṣyāmi iti abhāve+'pi

tad eva prakṣīṇamohāvaraṇaṃ sarvataḥ pradyotamānam anuviddhaṃ rajomātrayā dharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryopagaṃ bhavati sarvataḥ+pradyotamānam · yataḥ pramāṇena bādhyate yataḥ+pramāṇena · yadi punar idaṃ sarvataḥ pratyāhṛtyaikasminn arthe samādhīyate tadā bhavaty ekāgram ity ato na pratyarthaniyatam sarvataḥ+pratyāhṛtya · prasaṃkhyānavato dagdhakleśabījasya saṃmukhībhūte 'py ālambane nāsau punar asti dagdhabījasya kutaḥ praroha iti ataḥ kṣīṇakleśaḥ kuśalaścaramadeha ity ucyate kutaḥ+praroha

eta eva svasaṃjñābhiḥ tamo moho mahāmohas tāmisro 'ndhatāmisra iti eta+eva · sarva ete sālambanāḥ samādhayaḥ sarva+ete · sarva evaite kleśaviṣayatvaṃ nātikrāmanti sarva+eva · sarva eva amī kleśā avidyābhedāḥ sarva+eva

prāṇo yad bāhyaṃ vāyum ācāmati sa śvāsaḥ yad+bāhyaṃ · sthānād bījād upaṣṭambhān niḥsyandān nidhanād api sthānād+bījād · nanu buddhinivṛttir eva mokṣaḥ adarśanakāraṇābhāvād buddhinivṛttiḥ abhāvāt→adarśanakāraṇābhāvād +buddhi · tasyādarśanasyābhāvād buddhipuruṣasaṃyogābhāva ātyantiko bandhanoparama ity arthaḥ abhāvāt→tasyādarśanasyābhāvād +buddhi

sa puruṣo buddheḥ pratisaṃvedī puruṣo+buddheḥ · tasyādarśanasyābhāvād buddhipuruṣasaṃyogābhāva ātyantiko bandhanoparama ity arthaḥ ātyantiko+bandhana · tasya karmaṇo bandhakāraṇasya śaithilyaṃ samādhibalād bhavati karmaṇo+bandha · sā yadi śarīrapratiṣṭhasya manaso bahirvṛttimātreṇa bhavati sā kalpitety ucyate manaso+bahis

tad eva rajoleśamalāpetaṃ svarūpapratiṣṭhaṃ sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātimātraṃ dharmameghadhyānopagaṃ bhavati mātram→sattvapuruṣānyatākhyātimātraṃ +dharma · parānugrahapīḍābhyāṃ dharmādharmāv upacinoti pīḍābhyām→parānugrahapīḍābhyāṃ +dharma · ubhayasyāpyadarśanaṃ dharma ityeke adarśanam→ubhayasyāpyadarśanaṃ +dharma · pratyayakāraṇaṃ dhūmajñānam agnijñānasya kāraṇam→pratyayakāraṇaṃ +dhūma

khyātiviṣayā guṇādhikāravirodhinyo 'kliṣṭāḥ viṣayāḥ→khyātiviṣayā +guṇa · te spandamānā guṇādhikāraṃ draḍhayanti pariṇāmam avasthāpayanti kāryakāraṇasrota unnamayanti parasparānugrahatantrībhūtvā karmavipākaṃ cābhinirharantīti spandamānā+guṇa · ete guṇāḥ parasparoparaktapravibhāgāḥ pariṇāminaḥ saṃyogavibhāgadharmāṇa itaretaropāśrayeṇopārjitamūrtayaḥ parasparāṅgāṅgitve 'pyasaṃbhinnaśaktipravibhāgās tulyajātīyātulyajātīyaśaktibhedānupātinaḥ pradhānavelāyām upadarśitasaṃnidhānā guṇatve 'pi ca vyāpāramātreṇa pradhānāntarṇītānumitāstitāḥ puruṣārthakartavyatayā prayuktasāmarthyāḥ saṃnidhimātropakāriṇo 'yaskāntamaṇikalpāḥ pratyayam antareṇaikatamasya vṛttim anuvartamānāḥ pradhānaśabdavācyā bhavanti saṃnidhānāḥ→upadarśitasaṃnidhānā +guṇa · guṇā giriśikharakūṭacyutā iva grāvāṇo niravasthānāḥ svakāraṇe pralayābhimukhāḥ saha tenāstaṃ gacchanti guṇā+giri

sa khalv ayaṃ pratyavamarśo na syād asati pratyayānubhave sa+khalv · sa khalv ayaṃ dvividhaḥ sa+khalv · sa khalv ayaṃ vṛścikaviṣabhīta ivāśīviṣeṇa daṣṭo yaḥ sukhārthī sa+khalv · sa khalvayaṃ brāhmaṇo yathā yathā vratāni bahūni samāditsate tathā tathā pramādakṛtebhyo hiṃsānidānebhyo nivartamānas tām evāvadātarūpām ahiṃsāṃ karoti sa+khalu

avidyādayaḥ kleśāḥ kuśalākuśalāni karmāṇi tatphalaṃ vipākaḥ tadanuguṇā vāsanā āśayāḥ tad+phalam→tatphalaṃ · te ca manasi vartamānāḥ puruṣe vyapadiśyante sa hi tatphalasya bhokteti tad+phalasya→tatphalasya · tatphalasaṃnyāso vā tad+phala→tatphalasaṃnyāso · yathā ca jayaḥ parājayo vā yoddhṛṣu vartamānaḥ svāmini vyapadiśyate sa hi tatphalasya bhokteti evaṃ bandhamokṣau buddhāv eva vartamānau puruṣe vyapadiśyete sa hi tatphalasya bhokteti tad+phalasya→tatphalasya

yo hy anena bhogenāparāmṛṣṭaḥ sa puruṣaviśeṣa īśvaraḥ sa+puruṣa · tasmād yasya sāmyātiśayair nivirmuktam aiśvaryaṃ sa eveśvaraḥ sa puruṣaviśeṣa iti sa+puruṣa · yat kauṣṭhyaṃ niḥsārayati sa praśvāsaḥ sa+praśvāsaḥ · evaṃ tām ubhayīṃ koṭim anudhāvato yo 'syāpratīghātaḥ sa paro vaśīkāraḥ sa+paro

dvayos tulyayor ekasmin yugapat kāmite 'rthe navam idam astu purāṇam idam astv ity ekasya siddhāv itarasya prākāmyavidhātād ūnatvaṃ prasaktam yugapat+kāmite · dvayośca tulyayor yugapat kāmitārthaprāptir nāsti arthasya viruddhatvāt yugapat+kāmita · vartamānaṃ ca svakṣaṇe bhogārūḍham iti na tatkṣaṇāntare heyatām āpadyate tad+kṣaṇa→tatkṣaṇāntare · ayaṃ tu khalu triṣu guṇeṣu kartṛṣv akartari ca puruṣe tulyātulyajātīye caturthe tatkriyāsākṣiṇy upanīyamānān sarvabhāvān upapannān anupaśyan na darśanam anyacchaṅkate iti tad+kriyā→tatkriyāsākṣiṇy

naikasyāṃ striyāṃ caitro rakta ity anyāsu strīṣu viraktaḥ kiṃtu tatra rāgo labdhavṛttir anyatra tu bhaviṣyadvṛttir iti rāgo+labdha · viṣaye yo labdhavṛttiḥ sa udāraḥ yo+labdha · anādikālapracitasyāsaṃkhyeyasyāviśiṣṭakarmaṇaḥ sāṃpratikasya ca phalakramāniyamād anāśvāso lokasya prasaktaḥ sa cāniṣṭa iti āśvāsaḥ→anāśvāso +lokasya · sa karmāśayo lobhān mohācca bhavatīty eṣā tāpaduḥkhatocyate āśayaḥ→karmāśayo +lobhān

yad avidyayā vastv ākāryate tad evānuśerate kleśā viparyāsapratyayakāla upalabhyante kṣīyamāṇāṃ cāvidyām anukṣīyanta iti vastv+ākāryate · ko 'ham āsaṃ katham aham āsaṃ kiṃsvid idaṃ ke vā bhaviṣyāmaḥ kathaṃ vā bhaviṣyāma ity evam asya pūrvāntaparāntamadhyeṣv ātmabhāvajijñāsā svarūpeṇopāvartate madhyeṣu→pūrvāntaparāntamadhyeṣv +ātma · yathā kṣetrikaḥ kedārād apāṃ pūraṇāt kedārāntaraṃ piplāvayiṣuḥ samaṃ nimnaṃ nimnataraṃ vā nāpaḥ pāṇināpakarṣaty āvaraṇaṃ tv āsāṃ bhinatti tasmin bhinne svayam evāpaḥ kedārāntaram āplāvayanti tathā dharmaḥ prakṛtīnām āvaraṇam adharmaṃ bhinatti tasmin bhinne svayam eva prakṛtayaḥ svaṃ vikāram āplāvayanti tv+āsāṃ · syād āśaṅkā cittam eva svābhāsaṃ viṣayābhāsaṃ ca bhaviṣyaty agnivat su+ābhāsam→svābhāsaṃ

sa ca vipākas trividho jātir āyur bhoga iti trividho+jātir · asau karmāśayo janmāyurbhogahetutvāt trivipāko 'bhidhīyata iti āśayaḥ→karmāśayo +janma · tatra kṛtasaṃyamo jitvā tatsaṃbandhaṃ laghuṣu vā tūlādiṣv ā paramāṇubhyaḥ samāpattiṃ labdhvā jitasaṃbandho laghur bhavati saṃyamaḥ→kṛtasaṃyamo +jitvā · dvitīyaṃ rūpaṃ svasāmānyaṃ mūrtir bhūmiḥ sneho jalaṃ vahnir uṣṇatā vāyuḥ praṇāmī sarvatogatir ākāśa ity etat svarūpaśabdenocyate sneho+jalaṃ

atas tasyāṃ viraktaṃ cittaṃ tām api khyātiṃ niruṇaddhi tadavasthaṃ cittaṃ saṃskāropagaṃ bhavati sa nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ na tatra kiṃcit samprajñāyata iti asaṃprajñātaḥ sa+nirbījaḥ · sa na pramāṇopārohī na viparyayopārohī ca sa+na · tadāśritāḥ smṛtayaśca tadviṣayā na syuḥ viṣayāḥ→tadviṣayā +na · ete cittavikṣepā nava yogamalā yogapratipakṣā yogāntarāyā ity abhidhīyante vikṣepāḥ→cittavikṣepā +nava

grāhyoparaktaḥ pratyayo grāhyagrahaṇobhayākāranirbhāsas tajjātīyakaṃ saṃskāram ārabhate tad+jātīyakam→tajjātīyakaṃ · tatra śaucaṃ mṛjjalādijanitaṃ medhyābhyavaharaṇādi ca bāhyam mṛd+jala→mṛjjalādijanitaṃ · kiṃca parair asaṃsargaḥ kāyasvabhāvāvalokī svam api kāyaṃ jihāsur mṛjjalādibhir ākṣālayann api kāyaśuddhim apaśyan kathaṃ parakāyair atyantam evāprayataiḥ saṃsṛjyeta mṛd+jala→mṛjjalādibhir · tajjayād vatsānusāriṇya iva gāvo 'sya saṃkalpānuvidhāyinyo bhūtaprakṛtayo bhavanti tad+jayāt→tajjayād

tatra yad uttaraṃ taj jñānaprasādamātram yasyodaye yogī pratyuditakhyātir evaṃ manyate taj+jñāna · prāptaṃ prāpaṇīyaṃ kṣīṇāḥ kṣetavyāḥ kleśāḥ chinnaḥ śliṣṭaparvā bhavasaṃkramaḥ yasyāvicchedāj janitvā mriyate mṛtvā ca jāyata iti avicchedāt→yasyāvicchedāj +janitvā · tasmājjanmaprāyaṇāntare kṛtaḥ puṇyāpuṇyakarmāśayapracayo vicitraḥ pradhānopasarjanabhāvenāvasthitaḥ prāyaṇābhivyakta ekapraghaṭṭakena tac ca janma tenaiva karmaṇā labdhāyuṣkaṃ bhavati tasmāt+janma→tasmājjanmaprāyaṇāntare · udānajayāj jalapaṅkakaṇṭakādiṣvasaṅga utkrāntiśca prāyaṇakāle bhavati tāṃ vaśitvena pratipadyate jayāt→udānajayāj +jala

praṇidhānād bhaktiviśeṣād āvarjita īśvaras tam anugṛhṇāty abhidhyānamātreṇa āvarjita+īśvaras · yo hy anena bhogenāparāmṛṣṭaḥ sa puruṣaviśeṣa īśvaraḥ viśeṣaḥ→puruṣaviśeṣa +īśvaraḥ · tasmād yatra kāṣṭhāprāptir aiśvaryasya sa īśvaraḥ sa+īśvaraḥ · vācya īśvaraḥ praṇavasya vācya+īśvaraḥ

atha ke 'ntarāyāḥ ye cittasya vikṣepāḥ ke punas te kiyanto veti punas+te · sa khalv ahaṃ tyaktvā vitarkān punas tān ādadānas tulyaḥ śvavṛtteneti bhāvayet punas+tān · ekaikā punas tridhā punas+tridhā · lobhakrodhamohāḥ punas trividhā mṛdumadhyādhimātrā iti punas+trividhā

tasmācchāstrānumānācāryopadeśopodbalanārtham evāvaśyaṃ kaścid viśeṣaḥ pratyakṣīkartavyaḥ tatra sadupadiṣṭārthaikadeśapratyakṣatve sati sarvaṃ susūkṣmaviṣayam apy āpavargāt śraddhīyate tasmāt+śāstra→tasmācchāstrānumānācāryopadeśopodbalanārtham · tad etacchāstraṃ caturvyūham ityabhidhīyate etat+śāstram→etacchāstraṃ · ayaṃ tu khalu triṣu guṇeṣu kartṛṣv akartari ca puruṣe tulyātulyajātīye caturthe tatkriyāsākṣiṇy upanīyamānān sarvabhāvān upapannān anupaśyan na darśanam anyacchaṅkate iti anyat+śaṅkate→anyacchaṅkate · tathendriyasiddhir dūrācchravaṇadarśanādyeti dūrāt+śravaṇa→dūrācchravaṇadarśanādyeti

samānā hi tayoḥ kuśalākuśalayor maraṇaduḥkhānubhavād iyaṃ vāsaneti akuśalayoḥ→kuśalākuśalayor +maraṇa · tad yathā saṃsāraḥ saṃsārahetur mokṣo mokṣopāya iti hetuḥ→saṃsārahetur +mokṣo · kiṃca parair asaṃsargaḥ kāyasvabhāvāvalokī svam api kāyaṃ jihāsur mṛjjalādibhir ākṣālayann api kāyaśuddhim apaśyan kathaṃ parakāyair atyantam evāprayataiḥ saṃsṛjyeta jihāsur+mṛd · tapo na paraṃ prāṇāyāmāt tato viśuddhir malānāṃ dīptiśca jñānasyeti viśuddhir+malānāṃ

yathā tīvrakleśena bhītavyādhitakṛpaṇeṣu viśvāsopagateṣu vā mahānubhāveṣu vā tapasviṣu kṛtaḥ punaḥ punar apakāraḥ sa cāpi pāpakarmāśayaḥ sadya eva paripacyate yathā nandīśvaraḥ kumāro manuṣyapariṇāmaṃ hitvā devatvena pariṇataḥ tathā nahuṣo 'pi devānām indraḥ svakaṃ pariṇāmaṃ hitvā tiryaktvena pariṇata iti sadya+eva · ata ekabhavikaḥ karmāśaya ukta iti ata+eka · dharmāpekṣaṃ cittasya vastusāmye 'pi sukhajñānaṃ bhavaty adharmāpekṣaṃ tata eva duḥkhajñānam avidyāpekṣaṃ tata eva mūḍhajñānaṃ samyagdarśanāpekṣaṃ tata eva mādhyasthyajñānam iti tata+eva · dharmāpekṣaṃ cittasya vastusāmye 'pi sukhajñānaṃ bhavaty adharmāpekṣaṃ tata eva duḥkhajñānam avidyāpekṣaṃ tata eva mūḍhajñānaṃ samyagdarśanāpekṣaṃ tata eva mādhyasthyajñānam iti tata+eva

tad evam anādinā duḥkhasrotasā vyuhyamānam ātmānaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā yogī sarvaduḥkhakṣayakāraṇaṃ samyagdarśanaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadyata iti samyak+darśanam→samyagdarśanaṃ · tasyāśca samyagdarśanam abhāvahetuḥ samyak+darśanam→samyagdarśanam · hānopāyaḥ samyagdarśanam samyak+darśanam→samyagdarśanam · hāne tasyocchedavādaprasaṅgaḥ upādāne ca hetuvādaḥ ubhayapratyākhyāne ca śāśvatavāda ity etat samyagdarśanam samyak+darśanam→samyagdarśanam

tatrāhiṃsā sarvathā sarvadā sarvabhūtānām anabhidrohaḥ uttare ca yamaniyamās tanmūlās tatsiddhiparatayaiva tatpratipādanāya pratipādyante tadavadātarūpakaraṇāyaivopādīyante tad+pratipādanāya→tatpratipādanāya · steyam aśāstrapūrvakaṃ dravyāṇāṃ parataḥ svīkaraṇaṃ tatpratiṣedhaḥ punar aspṛhārūpam asteyam iti tad+pratiṣedhaḥ→tatpratiṣedhaḥ · evam unmārgapravaṇavitarkajvareṇātidīptena bādhyamānas tatpratipakṣān bhāvayet tad+pratipakṣān→tatpratipakṣān · yadi ca kathaṃcit puṇyāvāpagatā hiṃsā bhavet tatra sukhaprāptau bhaved alpāyur iti kathaṃcit+puṇya

sattvaguṇātmikā ceyam ato viparītā vivekakhyātir iti ato+viparītā · tathā ca hiṃsakas tāvat prathamaṃ vadhyasya vīryam ākṣipati tataśca śastrādinipātena duḥkhayati tato jīvitād api mocayati tato vīryākṣepād asya cetanācetanam upakaraṇaṃ kṣīṇavīryaṃ bhavati duḥkhotpādān narakatiryakpretādiṣu duḥkham anubhavati jīvitavyaparopaṇāt pratikṣaṇaṃ ca jīvitātyaye vartamāno maraṇam icchann api duḥkhavipākasya niyatavipākavedanīyatvāt kathaṃcid evocchvasati tato+vīrya · tapo na paraṃ prāṇāyāmāt tato viśuddhir malānāṃ dīptiśca jñānasyeti tato+viśuddhir · yato vyavahitānām apyāsāṃ sadṛśaṃ karmābhivyañjakaṃ nimittībhūtam ity ānantaryam eva yato+vyavahitānām

vindhyaścāprāpter agatiḥ aprāptyāḥ→vindhyaścāprāpter +agatiḥ · alabdhabhūmikatvaṃ samādhibhūmer alābhaḥ bhūmyāḥ→samādhibhūmer +alābhaḥ · apariṇāminī hi bhoktṛśaktir apratisaṃkramā ca pariṇāminyarthe pratisaṃkrānteva tadvṛttim anupatati tasyāśca prāptacaitanyopagraharūpāyā buddhivṛtter anukāramātratayā buddhivṛttyaviśiṣṭā hi jñānavṛttir ity ākhyāyate vṛttyāḥ→buddhivṛtter +anukāra · etat svabuddher agrahaṇe na yuktam iti buddhyāḥ→svabuddher +agrahaṇe

mṛdutīvro madhyatīvro 'dhimātratīvra iti tato 'pi viśeṣaḥ tato+'pi · yato 'sya mriyante gāva iti yato+'sya · tato 'sya prajñā yathābhūtaṃ prajānātīti tato+'sya · ayaskāntamaṇikalpā viṣayā ayaḥsadharmakaṃ cittam abhisaṃbadhyoparañjayanti yena ca viṣayeṇoparaktaṃ cittaṃ sa viṣayo jñātas tato 'nyaḥ punar ajñātaḥ tato+'nyaḥ

tac ca tasyaiśvaryaṃ sāmyātiśayavinirmuktam na tāvad aiśvaryāntareṇa tad atiśayyate tasya+aiśvaryam→tasyaiśvaryaṃ · cittaikāgryād apratipattir eveti jaigīṣavyaḥ citta+aikāgryāt→cittaikāgryād · pañcavidhaṃ nirmāṇacittaṃ janmauṣadhimantratapaḥsamādhijāḥ siddhaya iti janma+auṣadhi→janmauṣadhimantratapaḥsamādhijāḥ · bhūtāntareṣv api snehauṣṇyapraṇāmitvāvakāśadānāny upādāya sāmānyam ekavikārārambhaḥ samādheyaḥ sneha+auṣṇya→snehauṣṇyapraṇāmitvāvakāśadānāny

yatra kāṣṭhāprāptir jñānasya sa sarvajñaḥ prāptiḥ→kāṣṭhāprāptir +jñānasya · eṣā dvayī viśokā viṣayavatī asmitāmātrā ca pravṛttir jyotiṣmatīty ucyate yayā yoginaścittaṃ sthitipadaṃ labhata iti pravṛttir+jyotiṣmatī · duḥkhābhijñasya duḥkhānusmṛtipūrvo duḥkhe tatsādhane vā yaḥ pratigho manyur jighāṃsā krodhaḥ sa dveṣa iti manyur+jighāṃsā · ebhir jātideśakālasamayair anavacchinnā ahiṃsādayaḥ sarvathaiva paripālanīyāḥ ebhir+jāti

evam asya bhāvayataḥ śuklo dharma upajāyate śuklo+dharma · viparyayeṇāpy adharmo dharmaṃ bādhate adharmo+dharmaṃ · ye caite maitryādayo dhyāyināṃ vihārās te bāhyasādhananiranugrahātmānaḥ prakṛṣṭaṃ dharmam abhinirvartayanti ādayaḥ→maitryādayo +dhyāyināṃ · te khalv amī tryadhvāno dharmā vartamānā vyaktātmāno 'tītānāgatāḥ sūkṣmātmānaḥ sarvam idaṃ guṇānāṃ saṃniveśaviśeṣamātram iti paramārthato guṇātmānaḥ adhvānaḥ→tryadhvāno +dharmā

tathā vicchidya vicchidya tena tenātmanā punaḥ punaḥ samudācaranti iti vicchinnāḥ punaḥ+punaḥ · yathā tīvrakleśena bhītavyādhitakṛpaṇeṣu viśvāsopagateṣu vā mahānubhāveṣu vā tapasviṣu kṛtaḥ punaḥ punar apakāraḥ sa cāpi pāpakarmāśayaḥ sadya eva paripacyate yathā nandīśvaraḥ kumāro manuṣyapariṇāmaṃ hitvā devatvena pariṇataḥ tathā nahuṣo 'pi devānām indraḥ svakaṃ pariṇāmaṃ hitvā tiryaktvena pariṇata iti punaḥ+punar · parijñātaṃ heyaṃ nāsya punaḥ parijñeyam asti punaḥ+parijñeyam · svarūpaṃ punaḥ prakāśātmano buddhisattvasya sāmānyaviśeṣayor ayutasiddhāvayavabhedānugataḥ samūho dravyam indriyam punaḥ+prakāśa

tathānātmany ātmakhyātir bāhyopakaraṇeṣu cetanācetaneṣu bhogādhiṣṭhāne vā śarīre puruṣopakaraṇe vā manasy anātmany ātmakhyātir iti khyātiḥ→ātmakhyātir +bāhya · puruṣo dṛkśaktir buddhir darśanaśaktir ity etayor ekasvarūpāpattir ivāsmitā kleśa ucyate śaktiḥ→dṛkśaktir +buddhir · buddher eva puruṣārthāparisamāptir bandhas tadarthāvasāyo mokṣa iti aparisamāptiḥ→puruṣārthāparisamāptir +bandhas · deśakālasaṃkhyābhir bāhyaviṣayaparidṛṣṭa ākṣiptaḥ saṃkhyābhiḥ→deśakālasaṃkhyābhir +bāhya

yas tv asāv ekabhavikaḥ karmāśayaḥ sa niyatavipākaścāniyatavipākaśca asāv+eka · tāv etau bhogāpavargau buddhikṛtau buddhāv eva vartamānau kathaṃ puruṣe vyapadiśyete iti tāv+etau · tāv etau bhogāpavargau buddhikṛtau buddhāv eva vartamānau kathaṃ puruṣe vyapadiśyete iti buddhāv+eva · yathā ca jayaḥ parājayo vā yoddhṛṣu vartamānaḥ svāmini vyapadiśyate sa hi tatphalasya bhokteti evaṃ bandhamokṣau buddhāv eva vartamānau puruṣe vyapadiśyete sa hi tatphalasya bhokteti buddhāv+eva

kuśalaṃ hi me bahvanyad asti yatrāyam āvāpaṃ gataḥ svarge 'py apakarṣam alpaṃ kariṣyatīti 'py+apakarṣam · dveṣamohakṛto 'py asti karmāśayaḥ 'py+asti · hiṃsākṛto 'py asti śārīraḥ 'py+asti · nānayoḥ saṃkaragandho 'py astīti 'py+asti

ṣaḍ aviśeṣāḥ ṣaḍ+aviśeṣāḥ · ete sattāmātrasyātmano mahataḥ ṣaḍ aviśeṣapariṇāmāḥ ṣaḍ+aviśeṣa · tathā ṣaḍ aviśeṣā liṅgamātre saṃsṛṣṭā vivicyante pariṇāmakramaniyamāt ṣaḍ+aviśeṣā · tataḥ punar dharmādharmau sukhaduḥkhe rāgadveṣāv iti pravṛttim idaṃ ṣaḍaraṃ saṃsāracakram ṣaṣ+aram→ṣaḍaraṃ

sa kasmān na pramāṇam sa+kasmān · yo 'sau prakṛṣṭasattvopādānād īśvarasya śāśvatika utkarṣaḥ sa kiṃ sanimitta āhosvin nirnimitta iti sa+kiṃ · sa karmāśayo lobhān mohācca bhavatīty eṣā tāpaduḥkhatocyate sa+karma

sā ca samādhāv itarapratyayavan niroddhavyā iti samādhāv+itara · dvayos tulyayor ekasmin yugapat kāmite 'rthe navam idam astu purāṇam idam astv ity ekasya siddhāv itarasya prākāmyavidhātād ūnatvaṃ prasaktam siddhāv+itarasya · tataḥ punar dharmādharmau sukhaduḥkhe rāgadveṣāv iti pravṛttim idaṃ ṣaḍaraṃ saṃsāracakram dveṣau→rāgadveṣāv +iti

tadabhyāsapūrvaṃ cittaṃ nirālambanam abhāvaprāptam iva bhavatīty eṣa nirbījaḥ samādhir asaṃprajñātaḥ iti→bhavatīty +eṣa · sa karmāśayo lobhān mohācca bhavatīty eṣā tāpaduḥkhatocyate iti→bhavatīty +eṣā · śuceḥ sattvaśuddhis tataḥ saumanasyaṃ tata aikāgryaṃ tata indriyajayas tataścātmadarśanayogyatvaṃ buddhisattvasya bhavatīty etac chaucasthairyād adhigamyata iti iti→bhavatīty +etac

tadviśeṣān mṛdutīvrasaṃvegasyāsannas tato madhyatīvrasaṃvegasyāsannataras tasmād adhimātratīvrasaṃvegasyādhimātropāyasyāsannatamaḥ samādhilābhaḥ samādhiphalaṃ ceti tato+madhya · kleśakarmavipākānubhavanirvartitābhis tu vāsanābhir anādikālasaṃmūrchitam idaṃ cittaṃ vicitrīkṛtam iva sarvato matsyajālaṃ granthibhir ivātatam ity etā anekabhavapūrvikā vāsanāḥ sarvato+matsya · tato mithyājñānasya dagdhabījabhāvopagamaḥ punaś cāprasava ity eṣa mokṣasya mārgo hānasyopāya iti tato+mithyājñānasya

tadviśeṣān mṛdutīvrasaṃvegasyāsannas tato madhyatīvrasaṃvegasyāsannataras tasmād adhimātratīvrasaṃvegasyādhimātropāyasyāsannatamaḥ samādhilābhaḥ samādhiphalaṃ ceti viśeṣāt→tadviśeṣān +mṛdu · sa karmāśayo lobhān mohācca bhavatīty eṣā tāpaduḥkhatocyate lobhān+mohāt · yat tu dṛṣṭipathaṃ prāptaṃ tan māyeva sutucchakam tan+māyā
sa tu sadaiva muktaḥ sadaiveśvara iti sa+tu · etat trayaṃ yo veda loke sa tatra pratīkāram ārabhamāṇo bhedajaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāpnoti sa+tatra · sa tām āha sa+tām

śāstraṃ punaḥ kiṃnimittam punaḥ+kiṃnimittam · pratanūkṛtān kleśān prasaṃkhyānāgninā dagdhabījakalpān aprasavadharmiṇaḥ kariṣyatīti teṣāṃ tanūkaraṇāt punaḥ kleśair aparāmṛṣṭā sattvapuruṣānyatāmātrakhyātiḥ sūkṣmā prajñā samāptādhikārā pratiprasavāya kalpayiṣyata iti punaḥ+kleśair · evaṃ karmabhyo vipāke 'nubhūyamāne sukhe duḥkhe vā punaḥ karmāśayapracaya iti punaḥ+karma

tatra vyādhir dhāturasakaraṇavaiṣamyam vyādhir+dhātu · tatra pārthivādyāḥ śabdādayo viśeṣāḥ sahakārādibhir dharmaiḥ sthūlaśabdena paribhāṣitāḥ ādibhiḥ→sahakārādibhir +dharmaiḥ · hetur dharmāt sukham adharmād duḥkhaṃ sukhād rāgo duḥkhād dveṣas tataśca prayatnas tena manasā vācā kāyena vā parispandamānaḥ param anugṛhṇāty upahanti vā hetur+dharmāt

nāsikāgre dhārayato 'sya yā divyagandhasaṃvit sā gandhapravṛttiḥ jihvāgre rasasaṃvit tāluni rūpasaṃvit jihvāmadhye sparśasaṃvit jihvāmūle śabdasaṃvid ity etāḥ vṛttaya utpannāścittaṃ sthitau nibadhnanti saṃśayaṃ vidhamanti samādhiprajñāyāṃ ca dvārībhavantīti saṃvid→rasasaṃvit +tāluni · yady api hi tattacchāstrānumānācāryopadeśair avagatam arthatattvaṃ sadbhūtam eva bhavati eteṣāṃ yathābhūtārthapratipādanasāmarthyāt tathāpi yāvad ekadeśo 'pi kaścin na svakaraṇasaṃvedyo bhavati tāvat sarvaṃ parokṣam ivāpavargādiṣu sūkṣmeṣv artheṣu na dṛḍhāṃ buddhim utpādayati tad+tad→tattacchāstrānumānācāryopadeśair · ekacittatantraṃ ced vastu syāt tadā citte vyagre niruddhe vāsvarūpam eva tenāparāmṛṣṭam anyasyāviṣayībhūtam apramāṇakam agṛhītam asvabhāvakaṃ kenacit tadānīṃ kiṃ tat syāt kenacit+tadānīṃ

prasaṃkhyānavato dagdhakleśabījasya saṃmukhībhūte 'py ālambane nāsau punar asti dagdhabījasya kutaḥ praroha iti ataḥ kṣīṇakleśaḥ kuśalaścaramadeha ity ucyate saṃmukhībhūte+'py · kuśalaṃ hi me bahvanyad asti yatrāyam āvāpaṃ gataḥ svarge 'py apakarṣam alpaṃ kariṣyatīti svarge+'py · anāvaraṇātmake 'py ākāśe bhavaty āvṛtakāyaḥ siddhānām apy adṛśyo bhavati ātmake+'py

tathā vicchidya vicchidya tena tenātmanā punaḥ punaḥ samudācaranti iti vicchinnāḥ punaḥ+samudācaranti · kā punaḥ saṃskāraduḥkhatā punaḥ+saṃskāra · te ca karmavāsanānurūpāḥ yathā ca vāsanās tathā smṛtir iti jātideśakālavyavahitebhyaḥ saṃskārebhyaḥ smṛtiḥ smṛteśca punaḥ saṃskārāḥ ity evam ete smṛtisaṃskārāḥ karmāśayavṛttilābhavaśād vyajyante punaḥ+saṃskārāḥ

naikasyāṃ striyāṃ caitro rakta ity anyāsu strīṣu viraktaḥ kiṃtu tatra rāgo labdhavṛttir anyatra tu bhaviṣyadvṛttir iti caitro+rakta · yathā cikitsāśāstraṃ caturvyūhaṃ rogo rogahetur ārogyaṃ bhaiṣajyam iti evam idam api śāstraṃ caturvyūham eva rogo+roga · tasyaiva nāsty āśayo rāgādipravṛttiḥ āśayo+rāga
dveṣamohakṛto 'py asti karmāśayaḥ kṛtaḥ+'py · hiṃsākṛto 'py asti śārīraḥ kṛtaḥ+'py · nānayoḥ saṃkaragandho 'py astīti gandhaḥ+'py

saṃyogasyātyantikī nivṛttir hānam nivṛttir+hānam · siddhā bhavati vivekakhyātir hānopāya iti khyātiḥ→vivekakhyātir +hāna · pratipakṣabhāvanāhetor heyā vitarkā yadāsya syur aprasavadharmāṇas tadā tatkṛtam aiśvaryaṃ yoginaḥ siddhisūcakaṃ bhavati hetoḥ→pratipakṣabhāvanāhetor +heyā

nātra darśanaṃ mokṣakāraṇam adarśanābhāvād eva bandhābhāvaḥ sa mokṣa iti sa+mokṣa · sarvabhūmiṣu sarvaviṣayeṣu sarvathaivāviditavyabhicārāḥ sārvabhaumā mahāvratam ity ucyante sārvabhaumā+mahā · lobhakrodhamohāḥ punas trividhā mṛdumadhyādhimātrā iti trividhā+mṛdu

tato mithyājñānasya dagdhabījabhāvopagamaḥ punaś cāprasava ity eṣa mokṣasya mārgo hānasyopāya iti punaś+ca · sa yadi jātiśatena vā dūradeśatayā vā kalpaśatena vā vyavahitaḥ punaśca svavyañjakāñjana evodiyād drāg ity evaṃ pūrvānubhūtavṛṣadaṃśavipākābhisaṃskṛtā vāsanā upādāya vyajyeta punar+ca→punaśca · saṃbadhyamānaṃ ca punaścittena kuta utpadyeta punar+cittena→punaścittena
tasya lakṣaṇābhidhitsayedaṃ sūtraṃ pravavṛte idam→lakṣaṇābhidhitsayedaṃ +sūtraṃ · saṃyogasvarūpābhidhitsayedaṃ sūtraṃ pravavṛte idam→saṃyogasvarūpābhidhitsayedaṃ +sūtraṃ
ekam eva darśanaṃ khyātir eva darśanam iti darśanaṃ+khyātir · atha bhūtānāṃ caturthaṃ rūpaṃ khyātikriyāsthitiśīlā guṇāḥ kāryasvabhāvānupātino 'nvayaśabdenoktāḥ rūpaṃ+khyāti
sukham aham asvāpsam prasannaṃ me manaḥ prajñāṃ me viśāradīkaroti me+manaḥ · duḥkham aham asvāpsam styānaṃ me mano bhramaty anavasthitam me+mano

dīrghakālāsevito nirantarāsevitaḥ satkārāsevitaḥ tapasā brahmacaryeṇa vidyayā śraddhayā ca sampāditaḥ satkāravān dṛḍhabhūmir bhavati vyutthānasaṃskāreṇa drāg ity evānabhibhūtaviṣaya ity arthaḥ drāg+ity · sa yadi jātiśatena vā dūradeśatayā vā kalpaśatena vā vyavahitaḥ punaśca svavyañjakāñjana evodiyād drāg ity evaṃ pūrvānubhūtavṛṣadaṃśavipākābhisaṃskṛtā vāsanā upādāya vyajyeta drāg+ity

sā hi jananīva kalyāṇī yoginaṃ pāti jananī+iva→jananīva · eṣā dvayī viśokā viṣayavatī asmitāmātrā ca pravṛttir jyotiṣmatīty ucyate yayā yoginaścittaṃ sthitipadaṃ labhata iti jyotiṣmatī+iti→jyotiṣmatīty

yo 'sau prakṛṣṭasattvopādānād īśvarasya śāśvatika utkarṣaḥ sa kiṃ sanimitta āhosvin nirnimitta iti upādānāt→prakṛṣṭasattvopādānād +īśvarasya · ye tāvad antarāyā vyādhiprabhṛtayaḥ te tāvad īśvarapraṇidhānān na bhavanti tāvad+īśvara
tasmād yasya sāmyātiśayair nivirmuktam aiśvaryaṃ sa eveśvaraḥ sa puruṣaviśeṣa iti eva+īśvaraḥ→eveśvaraḥ · praṇavasya japaḥ praṇavābhidheyasya ceśvarasya bhāvanam ca+īśvarasya→ceśvarasya
yadi punar idaṃ sarvataḥ pratyāhṛtyaikasminn arthe samādhīyate tadā bhavaty ekāgram ity ato na pratyarthaniyatam ato+na · ato na sarūpaḥ ato+na

yadi ca cittenaikenānanvitāḥ svabhāvabhinnāḥ pratyayā jāyerann atha katham anyapratyayadṛṣṭasyānyaḥ smartā bhavet anyapratyayopacitasya ca karmāśayasyānyaḥ pratyaya upabhoktā bhavet pratyayā+jāyerann · yadāsya brāhmaṇasya hiṃsādayo vitarkā jāyeran haniṣyāmy aham apakāriṇam nṛtam api vakṣyāmi dravyam apy asya svīkariṣyāmi dāreṣu cāsya vyavāyī bhaviṣyāmi parigraheṣu cāsya svāmī bhaviṣyāmīti vitarkā+jāyeran

kathaṃcit samādhīyamānam apy etad gomayapāyasīyanyāyam ākṣipati etad+gomaya · na hi buddhiśca nāma puruṣaviṣayaśca syād gṛhītāgṛhītā ceti siddhaṃ puruṣasya sadājñātaviṣayatvaṃ tataścāpariṇāmitvam iti syād+gṛhītā

nāsikāgre dhārayato 'sya yā divyagandhasaṃvit sā gandhapravṛttiḥ jihvāgre rasasaṃvit tāluni rūpasaṃvit jihvāmadhye sparśasaṃvit jihvāmūle śabdasaṃvid ity etāḥ vṛttaya utpannāścittaṃ sthitau nibadhnanti saṃśayaṃ vidhamanti samādhiprajñāyāṃ ca dvārībhavantīti saṃvid→rūpasaṃvit +jihvā · nāsikāgre dhārayato 'sya yā divyagandhasaṃvit sā gandhapravṛttiḥ jihvāgre rasasaṃvit tāluni rūpasaṃvit jihvāmadhye sparśasaṃvit jihvāmūle śabdasaṃvid ity etāḥ vṛttaya utpannāścittaṃ sthitau nibadhnanti saṃśayaṃ vidhamanti samādhiprajñāyāṃ ca dvārībhavantīti saṃvid→sparśasaṃvit +jihvā

yady api hi tattacchāstrānumānācāryopadeśair avagatam arthatattvaṃ sadbhūtam eva bhavati eteṣāṃ yathābhūtārthapratipādanasāmarthyāt tathāpi yāvad ekadeśo 'pi kaścin na svakaraṇasaṃvedyo bhavati tāvat sarvaṃ parokṣam ivāpavargādiṣu sūkṣmeṣv artheṣu na dṛḍhāṃ buddhim utpādayati kaścin+na · tad anekaṃ janma yugapan na sambhavati iti krameṇaiva vācyam tathā ca pūrvadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ yugapan+na
evaṃ tām ubhayīṃ koṭim anudhāvato yo 'syāpratīghātaḥ sa paro vaśīkāraḥ ubhayīṃ+koṭim · tṛṣṇākṣayasukhasyaite nārhataḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām ṣoḍaśīṃ+kalām

īśvarapraṇidhānaṃ sarvakriyāṇāṃ paramagurāv arpaṇam gurau→paramagurāv +arpaṇam · ekasya cādhvanaḥ samaye dvāv adhvānau dharmisamanvāgatau bhavata eveti nābhūtvā bhāvas trayāṇām adhvanām iti dvāv+adhvānau

prasaṃkhyānavato dagdhakleśabījasya saṃmukhībhūte 'py ālambane nāsau punar asti dagdhabījasya kutaḥ praroha iti ataḥ kṣīṇakleśaḥ kuśalaścaramadeha ity ucyate 'py+ālambane · anāvaraṇātmake 'py ākāśe bhavaty āvṛtakāyaḥ siddhānām apy adṛśyo bhavati 'py+ākāśe

prasaṃkhyānavato dagdhakleśabījasya saṃmukhībhūte 'py ālambane nāsau punar asti dagdhabījasya kutaḥ praroha iti ataḥ kṣīṇakleśaḥ kuśalaścaramadeha ity ucyate ataḥ+kṣīṇa · kathaṃ tarhi varaṇabhedas tu tataḥ kṣetrikavat tataḥ+kṣetrika
tatraiva sā dagdhabījabhāvā pañcamī kleśāvasthā nānyatreti pañcamī+kleśa · eṣā catuṣṭayī kāryā vimuktiḥ prajñāyāḥ catuṣṭayī+kāryā

yad avidyayā vastv ākāryate tad evānuśerate kleśā viparyāsapratyayakāla upalabhyante kṣīyamāṇāṃ cāvidyām anukṣīyanta iti kāle→viparyāsapratyayakāla +upalabhyante · pūrvapariṇāmāpāya uttarapariṇāmopajanas teṣām apūrvāvayavānupraveśād bhavati apāye→pūrvapariṇāmāpāya +uttara
puruṣo dṛkśaktir buddhir darśanaśaktir ity etayor ekasvarūpāpattir ivāsmitā kleśa ucyate dṛś+śaktiḥ→dṛkśaktir · dṛśimātra iti dṛkśaktir eva viśeṣaṇāparāmṛṣṭety arthaḥ dṛś+śaktiḥ→dṛkśaktir

bhoktṛbhogyaśaktyor atyantavibhaktayor atyantāsaṃkīrṇayor avibhāgaprāptāviva satyāṃ bhogaḥ kalpate svarūpapratilambhe tu tayoḥ kaivalyam eva bhavati kuto bhoga iti kuto+bhoga · yato bhogābhyāsam anu vivardhante rāgāḥ kauśalāni cendriyāṇām iti yato+bhoga

anubhavakarmaviṣayatām āpannam tayor dṛgdarśanaśaktyor anādir arthakṛtaḥ saṃyogo heyahetur duḥkhasya kāraṇam ity arthaḥ dṛś+darśana→dṛgdarśanaśaktyor · ataśca dṛgdarśanaśaktyor nityatvād anādiḥ saṃyogo vyākhyāta iti dṛś+darśana→dṛgdarśanaśaktyor

sa cārtho hetur nimittaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavatīty anityākhyāyate iti→bhavatīty +anityā · dṛśirūpasya puruṣasya karmarūpatām āpannaṃ dṛśyam iti tadartha eva dṛśyasyātmā svarūpaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ iti→bhavatīty +arthaḥ

āryaputra apatyavatī me bhaginī kimarthaṃ nāham iti āryaputra+apatyavatī · śuceḥ sattvaśuddhis tataḥ saumanasyaṃ tata aikāgryaṃ tata indriyajayas tataścātmadarśanayogyatvaṃ buddhisattvasya bhavatīty etac chaucasthairyād adhigamyata iti tata+aikāgryaṃ
